createautocrafting.ponder.coil_scene.tex: Logic coils are essential for an autocrafting system
Stack Logic Coils into a multiblock to power autocrafting, with more coils allowing more crafting steps
To complete the setup, link the coil to a network with a stock link
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_1: Right-click the Stock Ticker to request Oak Planks
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_2: The Logic Coils schedule the crafting steps and gather the ingredients
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_3: The Vault packages up a raw Oak Log
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_4: A Frogport sends it along the Chain Conveyor to the Crafter
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_5: The Mechanical Crafter turns the Oak Log into Oak Planks
createautocrafting.ponder.coil_2.text_6: The Oak Planks are packaged and stored back in the Vault
gui.createautocrafting.plan.title: Crafting Plan
gui.createautocrafting.plan.subtitle: %1$s x %2$s
gui.createautocrafting.plan.no_coils: Not enough logic coils, need %s more
gui.createautocrafting.toast.title: Craft Complete!
Shift-right-click to set a 3x3 recipe and its result.
Put it in a Crafting Distributor to make its result craftable.
tooltip.createautocrafting.crafting_dist: A Packager that also stores Advanced Crafting Blueprints.
Right-click to open it. Shift-right-click with an Advanced Crafting Blueprint to insert it.
gui.createautocrafting.filter.both.desc: Click to show only craftable items
Click to show only items that can't be crafted
tooltip.createautocrafting.t1_unetched_p: A blank base. Dip it in the Etching Factory (100 mB of Etching Acid).
tooltip.createautocrafting.t2_unetched_p: A better blank base. Dip it in the Etching Factory (250 mB of Etching Acid).
tooltip.createautocrafting.t1_etched_pla: Goes in the middle of a Circuit Assembler. Makes 2 circuits per craft.
tooltip.createautocrafting.t2_etched_pla: Goes in the middle of a Circuit Assembler. Makes 4 circuits per craft, and is needed for Tier 3.
tooltip.createautocrafting.t1_circuit.1: Made with a Resistor and an Inductor.
tooltip.createautocrafting.t2_circuit.1: Made with a Resistor, an Inductor and a Diode.
tooltip.createautocrafting.t3_circuit.1: Made with every component, on a Tier 2 plate.
tooltip.createautocrafting.resistor.1: A circuit component. Needed for every circuit.
tooltip.createautocrafting.inductor.1: A circuit component. Needed for every circuit.
tooltip.createautocrafting.capacitor.1: A circuit component. Needed for Tier 3.
tooltip.createautocrafting.transistor.1: A circuit component. Needed for Tier 3.
tooltip.createautocrafting.etching_facto: Place it with an Energy Input and 2 Factory Cores in a 2x2 to form a basin. Right-click to check.
Fill with Etching Acid by bucket or pipe. Right-click to put plates in or take them out; automation works too.
tooltip.createautocrafting.circuit_assem: Place it with an Energy Input and 2 Factory Cores in a 2x2 to form the machine. Right-click to check.
Once formed, right-click any part to open it: plate in the middle, components around it. More components, higher tier.
The body of a factory. Two of these go in every 2x2.
2x2 = 1 controller + 1 Energy Input + 2 Factory Cores, flat, in any arrangement.
Accepts Forge Energy from cables. Place it in a factory's 2x2.
Right-click to see its charge. Etching Factory: 20 FE/t. Circuit Assembler: 40 FE/t.
message.createautocrafting.not_formed: Needs a flat 2x2 of this controller, 1 Energy Input and 2 Factory Cores.
